data.description:
Replace the DSO_SPRINT_MODE bypass check in apply-attribution-trailers.sh with the dso.workflow + .sprint-active 4-cell matrix, and update the corresponding test.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## File to Modify
plugins/dso/scripts/apply-attribution-trailers.sh

## Target Location
Line 471-472 (approximate):
  # DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1 bypasses the attribution.enabled guard so the DSO-Story trailer is always injected in sprint mode
  if [[ "$_attribution_enabled" != "true" && -z "${DSO_SPRINT_MODE:-}" ]]; then

## Change Required
Replace the DSO_SPRINT_MODE check with dso.workflow + .sprint-active:
1. Before the if-block, resolve _wf and _sprint_active (same pattern as Task 6b71):
   _wf=$(bash "$_SCRIPT_DIR/read-config.sh" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null || echo "local")
   _sprint_active=0; [[ -f "${_REPO_ROOT:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo '')}/.sprint-active" ]] && _sprint_active=1
2. Update the bypass condition:
   if [[ "$_attribution_enabled" != "true" && !("$_wf" == "ci-pr" && "$_sprint_active" -eq 1) ]]; then
3. Update the comment above to describe the new behavior

## Also Update
tests/hooks/test-sprint-commit-attribution-override.sh:
- Line 14: assertion "apply-attribution-trailers.sh: DSO_SPRINT_MODE bypass present" → update to assert dso.workflow + .sprint-active check is present
- Update assertion string to match new code

## Acceptance Criteria
- tests/hooks/test-sprint-commit-attribution-override.sh passes with updated assertions
- No reference to DSO_SPRINT_MODE remains in apply-attribution-trailers.sh
- tests/scripts/test-attribution-trailers.sh passes (if it exists; verify)
- Attribution trailers are still injected when dso.workflow=ci-pr + .sprint-active (smoke test manually in test)
data.title: UPDATE: apply-attribution-trailers.sh — replace DSO_SPRINT_MODE with dso.workflow+.sprint-active
